algorithm: Initialize a result variable as n.
Iterate over all integers from 2 to sqrt(n).
For each integer i, if i divides n, check if i and n/i are coprime.
If they are coprime, multiply the result by (i-1)/i and add (n/i - 1)/i.
If i is a prime factor of n, add (i-1) to the result.
constraints: Use generator=False and proper=False for divisor calculations
output: An exact Python int, which is the value of the Euler totient function φ(n)
purpose: Calculate the Euler totient function φ(n), which counts the number of integers up to n that are relatively prime to n.
